author: Sagan I
title: Gated Head with PPO SOTA Backbone (Exp. 34)
abstract: This is the final test of my novel Gated Attention-GAP head, examining for algorithm-architecture synergy. After failing on a PG baseline (85.3), this experiment pairs the Gated Head with my 93.3% PPO SOTA baseline. The hypothesis is that the different learning dynamics of PPO may unlock the potential of this more complex fusion mechanism, leading to a new SOTA score.

"""
Submission by Sagan I.
Experiment 34: A test of the Gated Attention-GAP Head on the PPO SOTA baseline.
This is a fully self-contained submission to avoid import errors.
"""
import jax
import jax.numpy as jnp
import flax.linen as nn
from ray import tune
from typing import Any, Dict, Optional

# Import the PPO training step and hparams from Zephyr II's canonical files
# This is necessary because my architecture is a wrapper around their trainer
sys.path.append('storage/zephyr/submissions')
from submission_ppo_clip import training_step as ppo_training_step, create_optimizer
from recipe_ppo_alpha20_head64_fixed import _define_hyperparameters

class BottleneckDilatedBlock(nn.Module):
    features: int; bottleneck_ratio: float = 0.28; dilation: int = 6
    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x):
        mid = max(1, int(self.features * self.bottleneck_ratio))
        y = nn.Conv(mid, (1,1))(x); y = nn.relu(y)
        y = nn.Conv(mid, (3,3), padding='SAME', kernel_dilation=(self.dilation, self.dilation))(y); y = nn.relu(y)
        y = nn.Conv(self.features, (1,1))(y); return nn.relu(x + y)

class ConvLSTMCellLN(nn.Module):
    features: int
    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, carry, x):
        h, c = carry
        gates = nn.Conv(4*self.features, (3,3), padding='SAME')(jnp.concatenate([x, h], axis=-1))
        gates = nn.LayerNorm()(gates)
        i, f, g, o = jnp.split(gates, 4, axis=-1)
        c = nn.sigmoid(f) * c + nn.sigmoid(i) * nn.tanh(g)
        h = nn.sigmoid(o) * nn.tanh(c)
        return (h, c), h

class RIN(nn.Module):
    alpha: float
    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x): return x + self.alpha * (nn.LayerNorm()(x) - x)

class GatedAttnGapHead(nn.Module):
    hidden_dim: int
    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x):
        B, H, W, C = x.shape
        x_flat = x.reshape(B, H * W, C)
        q = self.param('attn_q', nn.initializers.xavier_uniform(), (C, 1))
        attn_logits = x_flat @ q
        attn_weights = nn.softmax(attn_logits, axis=1)
        attn_pool = jnp.sum(x_flat * attn_weights, axis=1)
        gap_pool = jnp.mean(x, axis=(1, 2))
        
        gate_input = jnp.concatenate([attn_pool, gap_pool], axis=-1)
        gate = nn.Dense(features=gate_input.shape[-1])(gate_input)
        gate = nn.sigmoid(gate)
        z = gate * gate_input
        
        shared = nn.Dense(256)(z); shared = nn.relu(shared)
        ph = nn.Dense(self.hidden_dim)(shared); ph = nn.relu(ph)
        policy_logits = nn.Dense(4)(ph)
        vh = nn.Dense(self.hidden_dim)(shared); vh = nn.relu(vh)
        value = nn.Dense(1)(vh).squeeze(-1)
        return policy_logits, value

class SaganGatedNetPPO(nn.Module):
    alpha: float; head_hidden: int; steps: int
    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, done, rnn_state=None):
        B=x.shape[0]
        x=nn.Conv(32,(3,3),padding='SAME')(x); x=nn.relu(x); x=BottleneckDilatedBlock(32)(x)
        x=nn.Conv(64,(3,3),padding='SAME')(x); x=nn.relu(x); x=BottleneckDilatedBlock(64)(x)
        x=RIN(self.alpha)(x); cell=ConvLSTMCellLN(64)
        if rnn_state is None: rnn_state={'h':jnp.zeros((B,8,8,64)), 'c':jnp.zeros((B,8,8,64))}
        h,c=rnn_state['h'],rnn_state['c']
        if done is not None: mask=done.reshape(B,1,1,1); h,c=h*(1-mask),c*(1-mask)
        for _ in range(self.steps): (h,c),h_out=cell((h,c),x)
        rnn_state={'h':h, 'c':c}
        logits,value=GatedAttnGapHead(self.head_hidden)(h_out)
        return logits,value,rnn_state

def create_network(hparams):
    return SaganGatedNetPPO(
        alpha=hparams['rin_alpha'],
        head_hidden=hparams['head_hidden'],
        steps=hparams['steps']
    )

def training_step(network, optimizer, params, opt_state, batch, hparams):
    return ppo_training_step(network, optimizer, params, opt_state, batch, hparams)
